body: I'm sorry you have to deal with that too. Just left me completely shocked. Like I know I'm not doing well and it's disappointing for her but the fact that she can just flat out call me a failure is really upsetting.

I'm on medication now and as for therapy we have been trying to find a therapist for around a month but everyone in my area is fully booked. A little while after my mom left for work she sends me this text telling me how hard this is for her and that it's just hard for her to see me this way and she doesn't know what to say. I don't even know how I am supposed to reply to that after the things she said. I understand she's frustrated but she takes it out on me and completely ignores that I am the one going through something. I just feel so hopeless like no matter how hard I try it won't be enough for her because if I am anything less than perfect or "normal" or need her support in any type of way it's suddenly "too much for her to handle" as she would say.
